profile.headline: Full Stack Developer
profile.summary: Full stack developer having worked in both desktop and mobile development. I'm well versed in Vue, C#, and  postgreSQL but also have experience working with MEAN and MERN apps. Well rounded and adaptable, and I'm always looking to learn cool new stuff!

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.locationName: San Antonio, Texas Metropolitan Area · On-site
positions.description:
Designed and implemented a .net aspire maui application targeting IOS which services 100s of assessors in a distributed data access system with live syncing to assess & collect information on assets in various countries & regions.

Collaborated with 2 other peers to design and architect postgres/C# api solution through aspire to act as backend for the distributed data access, handling large datasets of over 1,000,000 records & thousands of photos.


Designed and maintained github actions & pipelines to release application api changes & ipa/executables to relevant distribution repositories, including to AWS resources.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Design and maintain Vue mobile application harnessing 3rd party APIs to streamline logistics processes. Integrating multiple apis to automate order shipment workflows. Specialized in implementing automated package weighing, label printing, and real-time rate retrieval, optimizing operational efficiency by 25% and shipment accuracy by nearly 100%.

Collaborated with a team of four in driving the development of a c# api used to communicate with a Vue mobile application and CRM system for a large-scale enterprise with over 150 employees.

Collaborated with a team of 4 to create C# service stack api which handles the syncing from the sage 100 database as well as internal routines numbering 10,000s of requests daily.

Audited and refined existing MEAN stack codebases to optimize
performance, security, and user experience. Proficient in implementing
user access controls and revamping UI elements to streamline navigation
and enhance overall usability

positions.title: Overnight Stocker
positions.description:
-Assisted at least 20 customers with any inquiries.
-Sort 3-5 pallets worth of merchandise into different departments 
-Record and transcribe any overstock and bin into designated racks.

positions.title: cap2 associate
positions.description:
-Received and sorted incoming freight into various departments in a timely manner.
-Assisted customers with any inquiries.
-Trained one employee on proper company procedures and time management.
-Record and transcribe any overstock and bin into designated racks.
-Maintain cleanliness and order in the backroom.

positions.title: Insider
positions.description:
-Trained multiple employees on time management and proper health procedures.
-Delegated to employees on a daily basis on proper sequence of store operations.
-Greeted and helped customers on a daily basis with any need.
-Maintained and recorded inventory on a regular basis.
-Maintained cleanliness to achieve a clean store front
